==Type of phonemes in Lojban==
*open phonemes:
**'''a e i o u'''
**'''au ai ei oi'''
**'''y'''
* closed phonemes: 
**'''bdgjvz''' (voiced)
**'''cfkpstx''' (unvoiced)
**'''lmnr''' (syllabic)
** glides: '''i u'''. they differ from open phonemes in that they are put only between two open phonemes or in the beginning of a word: '''.iaua'''. Here '''i''' and '''u''' are glides. '''iau''' is a glide with an open phoneme after it.
** h: ''' ' '''. It is put only between two open phonemes: '''.e'e''', '''.u'i'''
** word break: '''.'''
===Rules===
# in cmevla open phonemes can be put only between two closed phonemes: '''.sam.''', '''.no'am.'''
# cmevla start and end in closed phonemes except ''' ' ''' and additionally wrapped by a dot from each side.
# double consonants are merged into one: ''dd'' becomes '''d''', ''nn'' becomes ''n'' etc.
# if a voiced and a unvoiced consonants are next to each other '''y''' is inserted inside: '''kv''' becomes '''kyv'''. Or you can remove one of the letters instead: '''pb''' can be turned into a single '''p''' or a single '''b'''.
# if one of '''c''', '''j''', '''s''', '''z''' are next to each other '''y''' is inserted inside: '''jz''' becomes '''jyz'''. Or you can remove one of the letters instead: '''cs''' can be turned into a single '''c''' or a single '''s'''.
# if '''x''' is next to '''c''' or next to '''k''' then '''y''' is inserted inside: '''cx''' becomes '''cyx''', '''xk''' becomes '''xyk'''. Or you can remove one of the letters instead: '''kx''' can be turned into a single '''x'''.
# the substrings '''mz''', '''nts''', '''ntc''', '''ndz''', '''ndj''' are fixed by adding '''y''' inside or deleting one of the letters: '''nytc''' or '''nc'''.
#double '''ii''' between vowels is merged into a single '''i''': '''.eian.''' (but not '''.eiian.''')
#double '''uu''' between vowels is merged into a single '''u''': '''.auan.''' (but not '''.auuan.''')
